description: This file defines a connector registry providing discovery of available connectors like Jira and Confluence, including static bootstrap data and metadata structures.

classes.name: ConnectorCapability
classes.description: Represents a capability of a connector, such as search or create_issue.

classes.name: ConnectorMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata information about a connector, including name, description, capabilities, and documentation URL.

methods.name: List[ConnectorMetadata] list_connectors()
methods.description: Returns a static list of available connector metadata for Jira and Confluence.
